description: This file defines the OrderBuilder class used in unit tests to create instances of Order with default or specified values for testing purposes.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class used for constructing Order objects with default or custom values for unit testing.

methods.name: OrderBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the builder with default catalog item and order.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Configures the Order with a specified list of OrderItems.
